new_candidates.body:
Frame names in `<drake:parent>`, `<drake:child>`, `<drake:bushing_frameA>`, and `<drake:bushing_frameC>` are looked up among the plant's frames, not among the names the SDFormat source declares. So they also resolve to frames that Drake generates for joints, such as `foo_parent` and `foo_child` for a joint `foo`, including joints in included URDF and MJCF models. Those names are undocumented, and whether one exists depends on the joint's pose. A file can come to depend on one without anyone noticing, and then break when a joint's `<pose>` becomes the identity.

Raised in the review of #25132 ([discussion](https://reviewable.io/reviews/robotlocomotion/drake/25132#-P4yg6OZ-_nKWEeWR6GK)). The lookup predates that PR: master at 0b3db8d7c5 uses the same `HasFrameNamed()` / `GetFrameByName()` lookup.

Observed at 2166a5919b (#25132 r2), Linux, opt build.

**Repro.** This model has an SDFormat joint `foo` and a non-merged include `u` of `multibody/parsing/test/sdf_parser_test/imported_joint_frames.urdf`, which has a fixed joint `bar` from `R` to `B` with `<origin xyz="1 0 0"/>`:

```xml
<model name='m'>
  <include merge='false'><uri>imported_joint_frames.urdf</uri><name>u</name></include>
  <link name='A'/>
  <link name='B'/>
  <link name='D'/>
  <joint name='foo' type='revolute'>
    <pose>0.1 0.2 0.3 0 0 0.5</pose>
    <parent>A</parent>
    <child>B</child>
    <axis><xyz>0 0 1</xyz></axis>
  </joint>
  <drake:joint name='j' type='planar'>
    <drake:parent>NAME</drake:parent>
    <drake:child>D</drake:child>
    <drake:damping>0 0 0</drake:damping>
  </drake:joint>
</model>
```

**Output**, for each `NAME`, with `foo`'s `<pose>` as above and with an identity pose:

| `NAME` | `<pose>0.1 0.2 0.3 0 0 0.5</pose>` | identity `<pose>` |
|---|---|---|
| `foo_parent` | accepted: Drake's frame on `A` at p = [0.1 0.2 0.3] | error: "Frame 'foo_parent' specified for \<drake:parent\> does not exist in the model." |
| `foo_child` | accepted: Drake's frame on `B` at p = [0.1 0.2 0.3] | accepted: Drake's frame on `B` at p = [0 0 0] |
| `u::bar_parent` | accepted: Drake's frame for URDF joint `bar`, on `R` at p = [1 0 0] | same |
| `nope` | error: "Frame 'nope' specified for \<drake:parent\> does not exist in the model." | same |

**Expected:** only names that the source declares resolve: `world` (in the tags that accept it), and the links, frames, and models in scope, including the links and frames of included URDF and MJCF models (e.g. `u::B`, `u::Fc`). Any other name is an error, whatever the joint's pose.

**Possible fix** (suggested in the review): before looking a name up in the plant, check it with `sdf::Model::FrameNameExists()`, `LinkNameExists()`, and `ModelNameExists()`, plus the links and frames of the included interface models.

**Compatibility.** Files may already depend on these names; #24729 describes a model that relied on a generated `foo_parent` frame. So rejecting them may need a deprecation period. The alternative is to document them, which would first need these frames to exist regardless of pose, as #24729 proposes.
